The builder never gets the verifier's printf fixtures (a/b/c.jsonl, ok1/ok2/bad/missing.jsonl, `{"a":1}\n{bad}`), the "concatenation of single-file runs" comparison, the `git diff origin/main...HEAD` command, or the `gh pr view`/`gh pr checks` commands. It also gets no PASS/FAIL wording. What the builder does get is the behaviour from the issue: the exit codes, `-` reported as `-`, other files still reported when one can't be read, and lint unchanged. It is also told to write node:test tests for the cases in expect line 5, run `npm test`, and include the Closes line. The rule allows all of these. Lines like "stdout lines start with `-:<line>: `" restate the issue's output format for the builder's own tests. They are not the verifier's concrete `-:2:` probe with its inputs.
